standard.name: ASTM E588
standard.title: Detection of Large Inclusions in Bearing Quality Steel by the Ultrasonic Method

scope.purpose: Rates rectangular steel sections by immersion ultrasonic technique for large inclusions or clusters relevant to bearing steel lots.
scope.largeInclusionDefinition: Reflecting area equivalent to or larger than 1/64 in FBH in a similar steel reference block.

instrument.dynamicRange: Detect steel balls with 16:1 diameter ratio at a given sensitivity.
instrument.sweepLinearity: Minimum 80 mm sweep linear within 5 percent full scale.

searchUnit.newUnitQualification: Verify new units on system reference block.

tank.normalization: Manipulator angulates search unit in two mutually perpendicular vertical planes.

couplant.solution: Tap or distilled water with wetting agent.
couplant.rustPreventive: Permitted if it does not adversely affect test performance.

equipment.readout: Level counters, pulse counters, integrators, strip chart, B-scan, C-scan, memory oscilloscope, or computer techniques.

testSpecimen.condition: Rolled or forged condition; rectangular steel sections.
testSpecimen.surface: Prepared entry surface; avoid edge effects.
testSpecimen.penetrability: Verify ultrasonic penetrability before valid rating.

procedure.frequency: 10 MHz recommended for most bearing steels.
procedure.normalization: Normalize to maximum first far-field back reflection or from a hard steel plate on billet surface.

waterDistance.rule: At least 1 +/- 1/16 in for every 4 in of specimen thickness, never less than 1 +/- 1/16 in.

procedure.monitoringGates: Single or multiple gates may be used.
procedure.speedValidation: Recorded evaluation must be within 5 percent of scan below 1 in/s or one third normal operating speed, whichever is slower.
procedure.sensitivity: Background material indications must not exceed one half of the lowest counting level.

calibration.instrumentBlock: 10 mm hemispherically shaped hole block with target 1.7 in / 43.2 mm below entry surface.
calibration.level3Setup: Set largest ball signal to 80 percent full screen and set level-three counter threshold.

variables.V: volume tested = gated depth * scanned area

report: Reduction ratio from original as-cast section to inspected sample size

systemUse.autoFillProfile: Specialized bearing steel cleanliness rating, not general acceptance inspection.
